details.description: Pale champagne brushed-brass plate begins in a broad capsule end with a thin bevel; ACTON II is printed above the left control cluster.
details.scale: meso plate silhouette plus micro printed legend
details.affects: top control plate outline, bevel and left brand marking

details.description: Fine horizontal brass brushing runs continuously beneath the VOLUME, BASS and TREBLE legends without broad photographic highlights baked into the color.
details.affects: albedo, roughness and normal response of the brass plate

details.description: The right capsule end carries a POWER legend, red indicator dot and a raised gold toggle with concentric mounting hardware.
details.scale: meso control hardware with micro printed symbols
details.affects: toggle geometry, plated base rings and power labeling

details.description: Left control cluster contains a recessed AUX jack, a small brass SOURCE push button, three source status dots and BT/AUX/RCA labels.
details.scale: meso hardware plus micro indicator marks
details.affects: left jack, source button and source-status graphics

details.description: Three evenly spaced primary knobs use black fluted skirts, champagne-metal caps and narrow red position indicators.
details.affects: volume, bass and treble knob proportions and materials

details.description: A single raised brass play/pause push button sits between the treble knob and power toggle, with playback and skip symbols printed above and below.
details.scale: meso button plus micro printed icons
details.affects: right push button placement, material and playback legends

details.description: AUX and SOURCE legends sit below their matching controls while the plate bevel remains visible against the black recessed liner.
details.scale: micro typography and meso contact edge
details.affects: printed control legends and plate-to-liner separation

details.description: Each main knob has an asymmetric ring of fine black ticks, red accent ticks and 0/10 endpoint numbers.
details.affects: volume, bass and treble scale graphics

details.description: Skip-track icons and the power 0 mark occupy the lower right, while discreet end fasteners hold the inset plate.
details.affects: right-side printed legends and plate fasteners
